```{python}
import polars as pl
import requests #new for reading in JSON
import io       #new for reading in JSON
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}

# I obtained this data from: https://www.agentsfordata.com/json/sample

url = "https://byuidatascience.github.io/DS250-Course-Polars/Data/house-price.json"

# Use the requests library to send an HTTP GET request to that URL.
# The result (response) contains the server’s reply, including the file contents.
# The actual bytes of the file are in response.content.
response = requests.get(url)

# response.content is raw bytes, not a file.
# io.BytesIO(...) wraps those bytes in a file-like object in memory, which Polars can read from.
# pl.read_json(...) parses the JSON and loads it into a Polars DataFrame called df.
houses = pl.read_json(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```

```{python}
prophets = [76, 78, 91, 87, 80, 88, 81, 96, 95, 74, 90, 94, 87, 97, 90, 101]
pl.Series(prophets).mean()
```

```{python}
prices = houses.select('price').to_series()
prices.mean() # this gives a scaler. (Which is just 1 number, its not a list, matrix, or tensor)
```


```{python}
houses.select(pl.col('price').median().alias('average_price'))
houses.select(pl.col('price').min().alias('min_price'))
houses.select(pl.col('price').max().alias('max_price'))

display(houses.sample(5))
```

```{python}
# caculate the average price of bedrooms
houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg(pl.col('price').mean())
```

```{python}
houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg(
    pl.mean('area'),
    pl.max('stories'),
    pl.min('price').alias('min_price'),
    pl.max('price').alias('max_price'),
    pl.len().alias('row_count')
)
```

```{python}
houses.select(pl.len()).to_series().item()
```

```{python}
houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg()
```

```{python}
houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg(
    pl.col(pl.Int64).mean().name.suffix('_mean')
)
```



```{python}
(
    houses.group_by('bedrooms')
        .agg(
            pl.col(pl.Int64).mean().name.suffix('_mean'), 
            pl.col(pl.Int64).std().name.suffix('_stdev'),
            pl.len()
        ).with_columns(
            std_error = pl.col('price_mean') / pl.col('len')
        )
)
```


```{python}
(
    houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg(
        pl.col('guestroom'), pl.len()
    )
)
```


```{python}
(
    houses.group_by('bedrooms').agg(
        pl.col('guestroom'),
        (pl.col('guestroom') == 'yes').sum().alias('count_with_guestroom'),
        (pl.col('guestroom') == 'yes').mean().alias('count_without_guestroom')
    )
)
```


```{python}
(
    houses.group_by('bedrooms', 'bathrooms')
    .agg(
        pl.col('price').median(),
        pl.col('area').median()
    ).sort('bedrooms', 'bathrooms')
).head(5)
```


```{python}
houses.with_columns(
    pl.col('price').median().over('bedrooms').alias('median_price_by_bedroom')
)
```
